rules.rationale: Use average of available Year 6 Reading and Writing prior grades, recorded in the Year 7 export, as Year 7 English baseline. Does not authorise new grade conversions.
Use Year 10 English Language prior exam grade recorded in Year 11 export as Year 11 English baseline, preserving existing valid baseline. Does not authorise new grade conversions.
Year 7 ICT current grades compared with Year 6 Computing prior-assessment grade recorded in same Year 7 export; subject approval only, not grade conversion approval.
